note: Measured on the actual CI directory AFTER the run (before it was deleted): every tracked file of the commit was compared with its git blob (exactly, or after normalising the CRLF that git archive writes on this machine): 0 missing or different — so the CI run did not modify any tracked file. Untracked outputs (node_modules, dist, ci-output) are not part of the comparison; snapshotManifestSha256 is the hash of the sorted path+sha256 list of the tracked files as extracted. dirtyPaths is empty by construction: an archive has no working tree.
